notes.title: A Free Mode is coming + Updates + French and Russian Localization!
notes.notes:
I’m so thrilled to say [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227590/DominaTRIX__Hentai_Storytelling_Puzzle/]Dominatrix[/url] will receive a Free Mode! In this mode you’ll be able to select a range (1 to 6) to define how many pieces the puzzle will be divided into. Also, since this mode will be unlocked after you complete the ‘Story Mode’, you’ll be able to choose which puzzle you want to play. Check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659871/66b07d9b3ada42b7082b773e51458218b0e24c9f.png[/img]

In addition, there is a new option to make this mode more challenging: a ‘time limit’. If you turn it on, you can play a puzzle using the range of divisions you chose before you run out of time. If you can’t do that in less than 2 minutes, you’ll lose the game. New achievements will be available for this specific mode too.

Moreover, there is a new option that can hide the puzzle guide on both modes. If you turn it on, the puzzle guide on the left will be hidden. To make it visible again, turn it off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659871/85f9a20c89b1804a25234355ba8e9b28dae61ad3.png[/img]

Last but not least, EvangelineKara and Wkd Xeqtr, players from [url=https://discord.com/invite/j49htNK]Hentai Room Discord[/url], have translated the whole game to French and Russian! [b]I’m so thankful to both of them because now we can reach more players around the world. This means a lot to me, so thank you very much, guys![/b]

All things I’ve mentioned before will be available on the updated that will be released this Friday 3rd, so if you haven’t bought the game yet, it’s time to do it!

Thank you for supporting me and don't forget to follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room]Steam page[/url].
